paper_scope: A differentiable HiGS training method with a native CUDA backward and hierarchy-aware sparse/progressive training.

contributions.statement: A native differentiable HiGS backward with explicit gradient and topology-lifecycle contracts.
A hierarchy-aware sparse and progressive training method that reduces end-to-end training cost.
A reproducible analysis of speed, quality, memory, and failure modes across scene scales.

claims.statement: The tracked A100 R60 short-horizon, pretrained-Ply artifact contains three-seed aggregate groups for Train, Garden, and Bicycle under the masked-Adam study.
The proposed method reduces complete training wall time while matching final full-training quality across standard datasets.
claims.blocking_gate: The frozen 165-job confirmatory matrix (5 methods x 11 scenes x 3 seeds, 30k steps, A100) shows neither frozen candidate preserves quality at the pre-registered margins: higs_switch_12k PSNR paired-delta mean -0.196 dB (95% CI [-0.351, -0.054], margin >= -0.10 dB), SSIM CI [-0.00831, -0.00265] (margin >= -0.003), LPIPS CI [0.00260, 0.00720] (margin <= +0.005); higs_switch_21k PSNR CI [-0.618, -0.184] is likewise below margin. Neither candidate meets the >=10% wall-time reduction gate either (switch_12k speedup-ratio mean 1.102 < 1.111 required; switch_21k mean 1.164 but ratio 95% CI lower 0.753 < 1.0). higs_full preserves PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS at the margins (PSNR CI [-0.052, 0.037]) but is not faster (wall-time delta +19.9 s, speedup ratio 0.965). A quality-preserving >=10% end-to-end wall-time reduction was not demonstrated. Phase-3 topology-preserving exploration (exploration_topology_11s0, 4 methods x 11 scenes x seed 0, 44 jobs) additionally shows no HiGS candidate preserves quality at the seed-0 margins (higs_visible_27k PSNR CI [-0.275, +0.022], SSIM/LPIPS fail; higs_topology_27k PSNR CI [-1.462, -0.034]; higs_topology_30k PSNR CI [-0.925, -0.030] with speedup-ratio CI lower 0.796), while the plain official gsplat_27k early-stop control passes all gates at seed 0 (speedup-ratio mean 1.120, CI lower 1.067) - confirming the observed 27k speedup is ordinary early-stop rather than a HiGS mechanism. No HiGS candidate was frozen; no confirmatory matrix was run for HiGS.

claims.statement: A frozen 210-job A100 full-training matrix executed end-to-end with zero failed or missing jobs (original_3dgs 33, gsplat 48, higs_full 48, higs_proposed 48, speedy_splat 33); the proposed method trains from SfM initialization with lower mean peak GPU memory than the gsplat control (2.79 vs 3.72 GiB).

The official Speedy-Splat training path (pinned 34c45c6d with audited seed and simple-knn portability patches) executed a frozen 33-job A100 full-training cohort with zero failed or missing jobs on the same 11 scenes and 3 seeds as the HiGS matrix.
The method outperforms current training accelerators under their official implementations and matched quality targets.
claims.blocking_gate: Official Speedy-Splat runs (33 jobs) are now executed from the pinned upstream source (34c45c6d) under the frozen protocol; the claim remains blocked because Turbo-GS has not released training code and a quality-matched acceleration advantage over the official accelerators has not been demonstrated.

claims.statement: The training improvement generalizes beyond the A100 cohort.
claims.blocking_gate: Repeat the frozen training matrix on at least one consumer GPU and one additional data-center architecture, reporting separate cohorts.

claims.statement: The 30k from-SfM ablation pilot (5 scenes x seed 0, 40 A100 jobs) isolates visibility-masked Adam, progressive resolution, and switch-step sensitivity in benchmark/higs-ablation-protocol.json.
claims.blocking_gate: Requires completed ablation pilot results validated by validate_higs_ablation_results.py; do not mark supported until per-method tables and paired statistics exist.

claims.statement: A frozen 165-job confirmatory matrix (5 methods x 11 scenes x 3 seeds, 30k steps, A100) executed end-to-end with zero failed or missing jobs and passed validation by validate_higs_ablation_results.py against the frozen protocol (frozen_candidates=switch_12k,switch_21k).

Under the pre-registered non-inferiority margins (PSNR paired-delta 95% CI lower >= -0.10 dB; SSIM >= -0.003; LPIPS <= +0.005; wall-time >= 10% reduction), the confirmatory matrix shows neither frozen candidate (higs_switch_12k, higs_switch_21k) passes the PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS quality gates nor the >=10% wall-time reduction gate (switch_12k speedup-ratio mean 1.102 with CI lower 0.826; switch_21k mean 1.164 with CI lower 0.753); higs_full passes the PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS quality gates but is not faster than the gsplat control (wall-time delta +19.9 s, speedup ratio 0.965).

The frozen topology-preserving exploration matrix exploration_topology_11s0 (4 methods x 11 scenes x seed 0 = 44 A100 jobs) executed end-to-end with zero failed or missing jobs. Under the pre-registered seed-0 gates, the plain official 27k-step gsplat early-stop control passes all gates (PSNR paired-delta 95% CI lower -0.092 >= -0.10 dB; SSIM lower -0.0017 >= -0.003; LPIPS upper +0.0039 <= +0.005; wall speedup-ratio mean 1.120 >= 1.111 with ratio CI lower 1.067 > 1.0; TTQ faster), while every HiGS candidate fails the quality non-inferiority margins: higs_visible_27k PSNR CI [-0.275, +0.022], higs_topology_27k PSNR CI [-1.462, -0.034], higs_topology_30k PSNR CI [-0.925, -0.030]. The observed 27k acceleration is therefore attributable to ordinary early-stop, not to the HiGS mechanisms (visible/selective Adam, cached low-resolution window, full-resolution densification anchors); no HiGS candidate qualifies for a confirmatory matrix.
